scope: Read-only review of four byte-identical original Python files and the local checkpoint records. No source edits or external publication by this reviewer.
conclusion: No blocker for the bounded original-source/offline-controls checkpoint. The separate full consumer runner is not delivered or accepted; PROTOCOL-BUILD-001 remains open in these original bytes and has a separately planned repair.

closure.testImports: Each test dynamically loads only its adjacent implementation; standard-library test dependencies and self-created temporary files cover the rest.
modelRequestCoverage: build_request packet keys, bounded output paths, literal materials/history, sampling/timeout settings

consumerBrokerCoverage: validate_action declared fields, paths and bounded reads/writes

independentOfflineExecution.environmentControl: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and -B; no source or bytecode write in the old worktree.

findings.problem: A failed or timed-out build does not clear built_revision retained from an earlier successful build of the same source revision. A later observe can pass its guard even when the failed builder has cleared or partially changed dist.
minimalSourceCounterexample: installed=true and built_revision==revision after one successful build
Request another build at the same revision
Typecheck/build fails or times out; built_revision remains equal to revision
observe passes its revision guard despite the unsuccessful latest build and potentially changed output
findings.reproductionScope: Source-level state counterexample; no actual build or browser was run.
findings.checkpointImpact: Does not block preserving original bytes with this explicit limitation. Existing six broker tests do not cover this state sequence.
findings.nextStep: Separately invalidate prior build authority before a legal build starts; prove failure/timeout observation rejection before server/observer startup and successful recovery. S2 has scheduled a separate additive repair after the preservation commit.

executionInterpretationLimits: Four files close the offline import/test dependencies, not the full live consumer stage. Stage-local build-submission.mjs, consumer-check.mjs, protocol/task/system texts, starter/distribution, declared runtime and fixed-lock dependencies are separate required inputs.
The model-request entrypoint stores parsed source as inert JSON. The consumer broker has explicit tool-like action dispatch; these two executor roles must not be conflated.
participant-finished and exit 0 mean a finish action was received; completed=false can still terminate normally. Process exit does not establish successful task or product behavior.
The consumer broker does not attach PUI_STUDY_API_KEY as Authorization; no provider/authentication support is established by the offline tests.
No complete process/network sandbox, complete artifact admission/freshness, experimental advantage or uninformed participant outcome is established.
The other 17 old experiment scripts and knowledge-consumer/Dialog changes are outside this checkpoint.
This review is not a formal GitHub approval, merge authorization, fresh model experiment or #750 acceptance.
metadataAssessment: README and source-preservation.json accurately state offline closure, zero live executions, external stage dependencies, original uncommitted provenance, the open build finding and finish/auth limitations.
